Name: Cute Monster Fireplace
Author: AutomaticData
Description:
Replaces the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Monster_Fireplace]Monster Fireplace [/url]﻿with a cute kitty version.

Requires Content Patcher to work. Should work with other furniture replacers, as it just patches over the furniture tilesheet instead of replacing it, just make sure this mod is loaded last so your other furniture mod(s) don't overwrite it.

Manifest.Name: Cute Monster Fireplace
Manifest.Description: Replaces the monster fireplace with a cute kitty version.
